rongmei.title: Gaipui tan taan khang tei nang pum

lines: 1. Gaipui tan tan khang tei nangpum ti pat ro,
Heikhou tei poubaomei lungkieng lou puni,
Gaipui tan tan khangtei kagan reipat ro
Poubaomei tan tan khang kagan raoguang pu the.
Jisu khou lumlou makmei guai mu
Kandi khouhei lung ncham khuan sini,
Tingkao thang guang kariu datpui kan khou
Aniu zao hou ntangmak nu e.
2. Kagan hei dui e tingmik heirao guang the,
Nban chun guay npat louna lung laitho,
Kaipou rui changmun khou dingna khuan bam the,
Kamei nun guaita lakhang nkhuan na bam the.
3. Tingkao ram gaikhou tei tingsaeng zaeng lung ni,
Buh le nei gaanchuanga gaanmei nailak khe
Khoutei ndap tarimei naidat lak khe,
Tingkum ching aching jisu le lung champuni.
